newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Two French nationals killed by Kinshasa troops.
newsitem.headline: Two French nationals killed by Kinshasa troops.

text.p: Two French nationals were shot dead by men in uniform in the Zairean capital on Tuesday evening, a French diplomat said.

The two long-term residents of Zaire, Michel Tournaire and Herve Rigaud, were leaving a factory in the Western Limete district of the sprawling capital around 7.00 P.M (1800 GMT) when they were killed.
The identity of the uniformed killers was not immediately clear.
The attack happened as self-proclaimed president Laurent Kabila flew into the capital from the southern city of Lubumbashi following the triumph of his guerrillas in a seven-month civil war.
France is one of five Western nations that stationed troops in nearby Congo to evacuate foreign nationals from Kinshasa if necessary.
